decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp multi-sample step-like displacement around index 470 affecting all axes with apparent platform behavior, and (2) a coherent linear ramp beginning at index 725 across N/E/U. Other intervals show typical noise or smooth motion without ambiguous superposed changes.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample upward jump in N and E (≈+5 MAD) near index 470, followed by a sustained elevated platform through ~475; U shows a concurrent sharp drop (~−2.5 MAD) then partial recovery—suggests possible transient offset or co-seismic step with ambiguous return.

From ~725 onward, all three axes show coherent linear trends: N rises steadily, E rises more steeply, U drops linearly—this is not noise but a clear cross-axis ramping event; the abrupt onset at 725 (visible across overlapping windows) warrants inspection despite short duration.
